resources.string: One-tap Quick Pin, Quick Share, and Quick Track — the same shortcuts as the home screen.
Premium home-screen dashboard — quick actions, Snap/Pin/Share Photo, recent Vault history, toggles, and live tracking with photo.
Scrollable list of every favorite in your Vault — tap any entry to open it.
Pick one or more tags when you add this widget — it shows every spot carrying at least one of them, right on your home screen. Long-press to change tags later.
